title: CAUTIONS
text:
## CAUTIONS

Be sure that the washer is grounded. To avoid electrical shock, use a metal pipe for the ground connection. But, don't ground the washer with gas pipes or telephone lines to avoid the dangers of explosion or lightning strike


Do not put your hands into the spin dryer basket during spinning.
<PIC:Manual39_1>
{{image description: Caution illustration showing a washer with eyes and a hand pointing to or touching the lower side near a grounding or pipe connection.}}




<PIC:washing_machine1_02>
{{image description: Safety illustration with a large X over a hand reaching into a spinning wash tub, warning not to put hands into moving laundry.}}


Your fingers can be caught by spinning laundry and damaged. Never allow children to operate or play with the washer. Children playing with the washer may accidentally fall into the washing tub


<PIC:washing_machine1_01>
{{image description: Safety illustration with a large X over a child leaning into the washer opening, warning against children entering or reaching into the tub.}}


Disconnect the power cord from the power supply after use. Ventilation opening must not be obstructed by carpeting when the washing machine is installed on a carpeted floor. If the supply cord of this appliance is damaged, it must only be replaced by authorized technician appointed by the manufacturer, because special purpose tools are required. Warning to avoid overfilling and damages this appliance must be filled with the operator present using a moderate water supply pressure only.

title: PRECAUTIONS WHEN OPERATING
text:
## PRECAUTIONS WHEN OPERATING

### Don't use excessively hot water

(50 degrees C or more) Plastic parts may be deformed or damaged. Also, clothing may be deformed or discolored

### Before washing, empty all pockets

If nails or pins remain in pockets, they may damage the washer or clothes. Close the water tap a little if the water pressure is too high. Be sure to cover with the inner cover on laundry before spinning. This prevents laundry from being tossed out and damaged. To avoid water splashes, close the wash tub lid. Never splash water on the control panel.

title: INSTALLATION
text:
## INSTALLATION

### ENVIRONMENT

### Leave some space

Space at least 15 cm between the washer and the wall.

### Place the washer on a sturdy flat surface

If the washer is placed on an uneven or weak surface, noise or vibration may occur. (Allowable is 2 degrees)

### Never install the washer near water

Do not place the washer in steamy rooms or where the washer is directly exposed to rain. Moisture may destroy the electrical insulation and cause an electrical shock hazard.

### Avoid direct sunlight or heating devices

As plastic and electrical components are affected by direct heat, never place the washer near heaters, boilers, etc. Do not place under direct sunlight. Install the drain hose about 70~80 cm above the ground for pump model.<PIC:Manual39_24>
{{image description: Installation diagram showing a wash basin or drain with hose height marked 70-80 cm and a drain hose routed to the basin.}}


### CONNECTING THE DRAIN HOSE

1. Before connecting the drain hose, remove the cover (a) from the drain hole.
2. After pressing the joint ring (b), insert the drain hose (c) to drain direction.<PIC:Manual39_25>
{{image description: Drain hose connection diagram under the washing machine. It shows a hose connector with parts labeled b and c, inserted into the drain outlet under the base.}}


### MOUNTING THE LEGS

Lay down the washer with its back facing downward. Insert four legs into the leg mounting sections of the base corners of the main body. Insert the claw of the leg with the square hole of the leg mounting section, and push the leg in the arrow direction as shown in the figure until it clicks.<PIC:Manual39_26>
{{image description: Leg mounting diagram showing the bottom face of the main body, a leg, claw, square hole, and arrows labeled 1 and 2 indicating insertion and sliding to lock.}}

title: CLEANING THE MACHINE
text:
## CLEANING THE MACHINE

### CLEANING THE LINT FILTER

If the dregs are filled up in the lint filter after finishing the wash, push down and pull it out as shown in figure. Remove the collected lint and rinse the filter net<PIC:Manual39_27>
{{image description: Lint filter cleaning sequence. It shows removing the filter from the washer, opening or cleaning it by hand, and rinsing lint under a water tap.}}

### DRAIN FILTER

In case of incomplete drain, disassemble the drain filter with screwdriver (+) and remove lint from the filter as shown in the figure.<PIC:Manual39_28>
{{image description: Drain filter cleaning illustration showing a vertical tool or rod inserted into the drain filter area near the bottom of the washer tub.}}


### OVERFLOW FILTER

Pull the upper side of the overflow filter with two fingers into the hole A in the direction of arrow as shown in the figure.<PIC:Manual39_29>
{{image description: Overflow filter diagram showing hands removing or cleaning the overflow filter panel, with the part marked A at the top.}}

### CLEANING THE WASHTUB

First, fill water in the washtub to 'H' level, then drain water from the washtub simultaneously with operating wash cycle for 1~2 minutes. Close the washtub lid.

### CLEANING THE WASHER BODY

Wipe off stains on the cabinet and operation panel with soft cloth. Do not use benzene, thinners, cleanser, or wax, nor scrub the washer with a brush. Painted surfaces or plastic parts will be damaged.

## MAINTENANCE

### WHEN YOU LOAD THE LAUNDRY INTO THE SPIN BASKET.

Press the laundry evenly and put the safety cover into the spin basket drum as shown in the figure.<PIC:Manual39_33>
{{image description: Laundry loading diagram for the spin basket. A correct example with a circle shows laundry balanced under the bottom of balancer and safety cover; an incorrect example with an X shows laundry piled unevenly.}}

#### TO PICK OUT THE CLOTHING WHICH HAS FALLEN BETWEEN THE BASKET AND TUB
For safety, pull the power supply plug out of the socket.
<PIC:Manual39_34>
{{image description: Diagram for removing clothing fallen between spin basket and tub. Labels include spin, Spin dryer hatch, screw, and Brim, with a hand turning or removing a screw at the hatch.}}

1. Disassemble a screw from the spin dryer hatch.
2. The spin dryer hatch is fixed to the brim by the concave and convex parts at two places. Expand the concave and convex parts, and pull up the spin dryer hatch to remove it.
3. Remove the clothing.
4. Close the spin dryer hatch. Push in hatch firmly until the catch at the front is engaged securely.

#### TO PICK OUT THE CLOTHING WHICH HAS FALLEN BETWEEN THE BASKET AND TUB
For safety, pull the power supply plug out of the socket.
<PIC:Manual39_34>
{{image description: Diagram for removing clothing fallen between spin basket and tub. Labels include spin, Spin dryer hatch, screw, and Brim, with a hand turning or removing a screw at the hatch.}}

1. Disassemble a screw from the spin dryer hatch.
2. The spin dryer hatch is fixed to the brim by the concave and convex parts at two places. Expand the concave and convex parts, and pull up the spin dryer hatch to remove it.
3. Remove the clothing.
4. Close the spin dryer hatch. Push in hatch firmly until the catch at the front is engaged securely.
